says: In today's CI, the progress journal allows the projects next, next-integration, next-visual and tooling but not tooling-integration, so every callback from a tooling-integration law is dropped as 'vitest-progress: metadata unavailable' and every tooling leg's time table reads partial, with write gaps.
proof: vitest.config.ts:260 names the project tooling-integration; progress.ts:39 allows only ["next", "next-integration", "next-visual", "tooling"]. Main full run 44428278854, job 135239318310, printed 8 'vitest-progress: metadata unavailable' lines, all while .github/ci/progress-reporter.integration.test.ts ran, and its time table said 'Journal partial' and 'Reasons: write_gap. Gap starts: 2741, 2747, 2755.' The green leg in run 44426789535, job 135233711469, printed the same 8 lines and 'Gap starts: 2743, 2749, 2755.'
cost: On main's full run, a hung tooling-integration law, the kind that starts processes, is never shown as the last observed activity, and a real write gap on a tooling leg cannot be told from these.
